name: pi-memory
description: Bundled memory plugin for pi-coding-agent — persistent cross-session memory (/memory save|list|find|remove|recall|clear) stored in a single JSON file, zero native deps. Vendored locally because the upstream npm package (@amaster.ai/pi-memory-mem0) pulls mem0ai → better-sqlite3 (native, no android-arm64 prebuild) and cannot install on Android/Termux.
